lines.zh: 我贴着水面滑，影子在水里。
lines.en: I skim the surface and my shadow follows below.

lines.zh: 鳍在空气里扇，声音很轻。
lines.en: My fins beat the air with a soft sound.
I make half a turn in empty air.
The wind carries me faster than water did.

lines.zh: 我飘过一片芦苇，没碰倒一根。
lines.en: I drift over reeds without bending one.

lines.zh: 我压低飞行高度，藏住自己。
lines.en: I fly low to keep myself hidden.
This body is so light the wind bends it.

lines.zh: 我悬在小路上面，看下面的人。
lines.en: I hang above the path and watch who walks it.

lines.zh: 我飘着走，尾巴在后面摆。
lines.en: I drift along with my tail swaying behind.

lines.zh: 这一带每条路我都飞过了。
lines.en: I have flown every road in this area.

lines.zh: 我顺着气流爬高，再滑下去。
lines.en: I ride the air up, then let it fall away.
My shadow sweeps across the field.
I round the treetops and head for the village.
My eyes stay fixed while my body drifts.

lines.zh: 我在水面和天空之间来回。
lines.en: I pass back and forth between water and sky.
Air hisses along my fins.

lines.zh: 我停在麦穗上方，鳍不摇。
lines.en: I hover above the wheat ears without moving a fin.

lines.zh: 我的身体透明得能看见水。
lines.en: I am so clear you can see the water inside me.
I stare at a road far off.
The wind rocks my body.

lines.zh: 水珠从我的鳍尖掉下去。
lines.en: Droplets fall from my fin tips.
I rotate slowly and sweep the horizon.
I have no mouth, so I cannot speak.

lines.zh: 我浮在田地上方，等天黑。
lines.en: I float above the field and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 海嗣里像我这样的不少。
lines.en: There are many like me among the seaborn.

lines.zh: 我听着下面的声音，分辨方位。
lines.en: I listen below and sort out directions.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在一口井上。
lines.en: My shadow falls across a well.
I know these villages well.
I flick my fins and steady again.
Damp gathers into mist around me.
You looked up. I know.

lines.zh: 我一直浮在你上方，海嗣的影子里。
lines.en: I hover above you, in the seaborn's shadow.
You cannot see me and cannot escape me.

lines.zh: 你手里没有能打远的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in your hands reaches far.
I drift, motionless, and only watch.
You step back and I shift with you.
Do not call for help. I act first if you do.
These scales need no air.

lines.zh: 我在你视野边上，慢慢飘。
lines.en: I drift at the edge of your sight.
I am waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 我的身体被切开又合上。
lines.en: My body is cut open and closes again.
That scattered me for an instant.

lines.zh: 我飘不稳，往下沉了一格。
lines.en: I lose my hold and sink a block.
A fin is torn and my flight skews.

lines.zh: 我退了很远，才重新聚形。
lines.en: I retreat far before gathering my shape.
Pain is new. I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 水从我身上流出来，不是血。
lines.en: Water runs out of me, not blood.

lines.zh: 我又飘正了，但慢了一拍。
lines.en: I level out again, one beat slow.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了这个位置。
lines.en: I have noted that strike's position.
I climb to avoid the next one.
Fish? I would eat that.

lines.zh: 我贴着鱼桶边缘转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the rim of the fish bucket once.

lines.zh: 食物飘上来了，我降下去。
lines.en: The smell rises; I descend.
I hang over the fish bucket without moving.
You use that to tempt me. Good.
One taste. Still fresh.

lines.zh: 这味道让我的鳍张开了。
lines.en: The smell spreads my fins.
I swallow it bones and all.

lines.zh: 再来一条，我就送你一件事。
lines.en: One more and I will do you a favor.
The fish is mine. You lose nothing.

lines.zh: 你撞到了空气，我早飘开。
lines.en: You hit empty air. I drifted off.
Stop swinging at the sky.
I am light. One touch and I spring away.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的鳍了，算你运气。
lines.en: You touched my fin. Count yourself lucky.
I draw back half a block.
Impact means little to me.
That touch above your head was me.
Get clear. I am coming down.
One touch and my shape scatters.
That is not enough to stop me.

lines.zh: 水里那些同类，不认得我。
lines.en: My kind in the water do not know me.

lines.zh: 我们在空中交错，不说话。
lines.en: We cross paths in the air without words.

lines.zh: 我的身体可以分开，再合上。
lines.en: My body can divide and rejoin.

lines.zh: 有一次，两具身体合成了一具。
lines.en: Once two bodies merged into one.
After that, it was gone.
We build no nest and need none.

lines.zh: 觅食的时候我们会同行。
lines.en: We travel together while hunting.
Whoever stops first scatters first.
I remember what it looked like in the water.
When we part, there is no farewell.

lines.zh: 那条鱼落下来了，我叼住。
lines.en: The fish fell. I caught it.
I snatch a strip of meat from midair.
A shell has caught on my fin.

lines.zh: 我低下头，衔起一根绳子。
lines.en: I dip down and take up a rope.
My fins can grip things.

lines.zh: 这枚珠子从手里滚出来了。
lines.en: This orb rolled out of someone's hand.
I swallow it so I need not carry it.
Something edible dropped below. Perfect.
I drift over and scoop it up.
This shiny thing. I will hold it first.
Someone is on that road.
I have his head lined up.
I come around from the side.

lines.zh: 我飘到一个够得着的地方。
lines.en: I drift into reach.
He keeps walking and does not look up.
My body narrows into a line.
From here he cannot block.
I gather vapor along my fins.

lines.zh: 我在半空转了半圈，对准你。
lines.en: I turn half a circle in the air and aim at you.
I settle in behind him.
I turn slowly above his head.
Wherever he goes, I drift.
He has not looked up once.

lines.zh: 我等他走到没有遮挡的地方。
lines.en: I wait for him to reach open ground.
The wind pushed me a little off.
I adjust my position again.

lines.zh: 这条路上只有他一个人。
lines.en: He is the only one on this road.
My shadow lands in front of his feet.
He glanced and did not care.

lines.zh: 我把高度降到树梢下面。
lines.en: I drop below the treetops.
I dive straight down from above.

lines.zh: 鳍边凝成的水直接打过去。
lines.en: The water along my fins lashes out.
I strike his shoulder and rebound.
My body passes right through beside him.

lines.zh: 这一下带着海水的力气。
lines.en: There is seawater behind that blow.
My tail whips across his face.

lines.zh: 他抬手，我从手臂下面进。
lines.en: He raises a guard; I come in under it.

lines.zh: 我贴着他的胸口打出去。
lines.en: I strike from right against his chest.
He grabs me and I scatter into mist.
I reform and hit again.
A white mist rises off the water.
I drift out of that mist.
Half of this sky is mine.
I spread my fins and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 几十只像我一样的，一起出现在地表。
lines.en: Dozens like me appear across the land.

lines.zh: 我飘在麦田上面，看着村子。
lines.en: I float over the wheat and look at the village.

lines.zh: 你只能看见一团扭曲的光。
lines.en: You can only see a warped patch of light.

lines.zh: 湿气先落，露水打湿麦叶。
lines.en: My dampness falls first, wetting the wheat leaves.

lines.zh: 这地方离海很远，也照样来。
lines.en: This place is far from the sea. I come anyway.
The wind brought me, not my feet.
Fire touched my fin and I turned to mist.
The air cut out and I dropped straight down.

lines.zh: 我被按进水里，形状在散。
lines.en: Held under water, my shape comes apart.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹得散开了一瞬。
lines.en: The blast tore me apart for a moment.
An arrow passed through my body.

lines.zh: 这股力量锁住我的形状。
lines.en: This force has locked my shape.

lines.zh: 没有鱼，我的身体变淡了。
lines.en: Without fish my body fades.

lines.zh: 雷光顺着我的鳍跑上来。
lines.en: Lightning ran up along my fins.

lines.zh: 空气没了，我掉进一片虚空。
lines.en: The air was gone and I fell into nothing.
